name: settleview_feed_polymarket

query_condition.sql: SELECT stream, min(value) AS v FROM "settleview_stream_stale" WHERE venue = 'polymarket' GROUP BY stream HAVING min(value) >= 1

description: Polymarket feed stale: a Polymarket book has not been servable for 5 min.

context_attributes.slo: Each Polymarket stream servable 99% of minutes (7 days); fires after 5 min.
